overview_description.description:
Macro is the secure, intelligent document management platform seamlessly integrated with AI, where users can efficiently read and analyze PDF files, create markdown notes, write code and design charts and diagrams—all within one, unified platform.

Of particular note, Macro features a modern, intuitive user interface (UI) to streamline the workflow and productivity for consumers and enterprises alike. The built-in markdown editor, PDF markup tools, and AI-powered chat, among other workflow automation features, are stitched cohesively to contribute towards improved research quality and reliability in insights and traceability via in-line citations.
